tasks.label: Apply README update
tasks.command: git checkout --theirs README.md && git add README.md && GIT_EDITOR=true git rebase --continue

tasks.label: Restore local task changes
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && git stash list && git stash pop

tasks.label: Push main to origin
tasks.command: git push origin main && git status --short --branch

tasks.label: Inspect frontend audit
tasks.command: npm view next version && npm audit --audit-level=high --json

tasks.label: Inspect dependency changes
tasks.command: git status --short --branch && git diff -- apps/web/package.json package.json apps/web/tsconfig.json package-lock.json | sed -n '1,240p'

tasks.label: Inspect latest commit
tasks.command: git --no-pager log -3 --oneline --decorate && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git diff HEAD -- apps/web/package.json package-lock.json | sed -n '1,180p'

tasks.label: Inspect generated config changes
tasks.command: git diff -- apps/web/next-env.d.ts apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo | sed -n '1,220p'

tasks.label: Push audit fix
tasks.command: git push origin main && git status --short --branch
